title: Customer Service / Sales Advisor
description:
Assistant Sales / Customer Advisor (Insurance)

What you'll be doing

Using leads provided, you will engage with personal lines customers throughout NI / GB in order to promote and sell our non-standard home & car insurance product as well as assisting / supporting customers with any related queries and re any changes / amendments required in relation to their policy

Role Purpose

Using the leads generated, to outbound call clients, selling and cross selling the non- standard home & car product and any other relevant personal lines insurance products within company set sales targets (individual and overall branch/company target)

To provide the highest standards of customer care, service, and client retention.

To give advice to customers, explain why a particular product or provider would best meet the demands and needs of the customer, and give recommendations tailored to the customer's requirements.

To always ensure best practice in line current legal and regulatory requirements

Your responsibilities

Achieving personal monthly targets whilst maintaining the correct standards of work and quality and as required by the Financial Conduct Authority (our regulator).

Be a role model for the Company, by always presenting a professional image.

Adhering to regulations and requirements of the Financial Conduct Authority (our regulator).

Providing expert and prompt advice to new and existing customers regarding their insurance needs, e.g., handling adjustments, renewals and any other queries which may arise.

Providing quotations and arranging new business via computerised rating guides.

Maximising all sales opportunities to include cross selling and dealing with prospects efficiently and effectively.

Identifying and following up on potential customers quickly and professionally.

Effectively and efficiently handle policy adjustments, renewals and any other queries which may arise.

Handling customer complaints in accordance with company procedures, calmly and with empathy.

Achieving personal monthly targets whilst maintaining acceptable standards of work and quality.

Dealing with all business clients in a professional manner.

Maintain effective communication with all contacts, including insurance companies.

Being a corporate ambassador by always presenting a professional image

General Duties

Complying with all relevant company policies and procedures, including health and safety procedures.

Carrying out any other roles /functions as necessary by the Manager to support the effective operation of the branch.

Your role at a glance

It is very customer focused sales role with the provision of exceptional customer service at the heart of everything you do and you will be working towards individual, and company set monthly targets.

There are no budgetary or staffing responsibilities.

title: Trainee Sales Advisor
description:
Trainee Insurance Sales Advisor / Junior Sales Advisor

Location: Ipswich, Suffolk (On-site)

Salary: £21,000 - £26,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Experience Level: Entry Level / Trainee (No experience required)

Are you looking to launch a rewarding, fast-paced career in the financial services sector? Massenhove Recruitment Limited is seeking a motivated Trainee Insurance Sales Advisor / Junior Sales Assistant to join a growing team in Ipswich, Suffolk.

This is an exceptional entry-level sales opportunity. You will receive industry-leading training on insurance products, regulations, and customer management, making it the perfect stepping stone for an ambitious individual looking for career progression.

Role Purpose & Overview

As an Insurance Sales Advisor, you will be the first point of contact for clients across the UK looking for specialised insurance cover for non-standard home and motor insurance policies.

This role perfectly blends sales execution with high-quality customer service, ensuring all clients receive tailored advice that matches their insurance needs.

Key Responsibilities
- Sales & Business Development: Contact provided leads to quote, sell, and cross-sell personal lines insurance products (home and car insurance).
- Customer Relationship Management: Provide expert advice to new and existing customers regarding policy adjustments, mid-term amendments, and renewals.
- Target Achievement: Meet and exceed personal monthly sales targets while maintaining excellent quality standards.
- Compliance & FCA Regulation: Ensure all sales practices strictly adhere to the guidelines set by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).
- Client Retention: Handle customer queries and complaints with empathy, professionalism, and speed to maximize retention.
- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and professional communication with insurance companies, underwriters, and internal branch managers.

What We Are Looking For (Skills & Requirements)
- Entry-Level Candidates Welcome: No prior insurance experience is required; full training is provided.
- Strong Communication Skills: An excellent telephone manner with the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Target-Driven Mindset: Motivation to work towards individual and team sales targets.
- Problem-Solving Ability: A customer-focused approach to handling queries and resolving complaints calmly.
- Professionalism: Ability to act as a corporate ambassador for the company at all times.

What's in It for You?
- Competitive Salary: £21,000 - £26,000 per annum.
- Comprehensive Training: Learn everything you need to know about the insurance sector from industry experts.
- Career Growth: A structured pathway into professional insurance and financial services roles.
- Stable Environment: A full-time, permanent position within a supportive local branch.

About Us:

Massenhove Recruitment Limited is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We recruit solely on merit, treating all candidates with equality, fairness, and respect.

Apply Today: If you are ready to kickstart a dynamic career in insurance sales, apply now for a confidential discussion!

title: Customer Success Advisor

- Proactively promote Freightliner Connect's capabilities to identify upselling opportunities, increase customer engagement, and deliver incremental revenue growth.
- Support account development plans by identifying opportunities to expand customer spend, improve retention, and enhance overall commercial performance.
Key Measures:
- Account Adoption of Freightliner Connect
- Drive customer adoption and utilisation of Freightliner Connect, embedding the platform within customers' operating models to increase engagement, retention and long-term account value.
- Lead adoption initiatives across strategic accounts, ensuring customers maximise the value of Freightliner CONNECT's capabilities and digital services.
- Develop and execute account adoption plans that improve customer engagement, strengthen relationships and increase platform utilisation.

- Proactive approach to work and uses own initiative to implement improvements.
- Sets high standards of work for self, and team,
- High level of integrity and openness
- Energetic, highly motivated, in pursuit of business growth and success.
- Leads by example
Benefits:

title: Internal Sales Account Manager
description:
We are currently recruiting on behalf of an established and growing business operating within a specialist technical services sector. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced sales professional to join a successful team in a role combining new business development, account management and project sales.

The successful candidate will take ownership of a portfolio of customers while also identifying and developing new commercial opportunities. You will work with a varied client base, helping them find the right solutions for their projects.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers.
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities through proactive sales activity.
- Handle incoming sales enquiries and convert opportunities into profitable business.
- Research prospective customers and generate new leads using a range of sources and sales tools.
- Contact prospective clients by telephone, email and other appropriate channels.
- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
- Review project information, drawings and specifications to establish customer requirements.
- Prepare accurate and commercially competitive quotations.
- Follow up quotations and manage opportunities through to completion.
- Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and sales information within the company's CRM system.
- Provide a high level of customer service throughout the sales process.
- Develop knowledge of the company's products and technical solutions, with full training provided.
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure projects and customer requirements are handled efficiently.
- Contribute ideas and feedback

Previous Skills & Experience:
- Proven Sales Account Management or BDM experience, with a proactive approach to developing profitable relationships
- Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build successful, mutually beneficial business relationships
- Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle and overcome objections
- Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and focused on meeting and exceeding targets
- Excellent planning, organisational, and time management skills

Salary: 28,000- 33,000 + uncapped commission
